case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

design.purpose: A raised open planter for herbs or flowers for one gardener; interior about 36 × 14 cm with 20 cm soil depth above the base, filled to 15 cm by the user after filming.

steps.c: Place the 120 cm wide board flat for cutting.
Cut front 40, back 40, ends 14 cm each, keep offcut.
Place the 120 cm board flat for cutting.
Cut the 40 cm base and keep the offcut.
Place the 120 cm narrow board flat for cutting.
Cut two 24 cm feet and keep the offcut.
Sand all cut edges of the planter parts smooth.
Drill three drainage holes through the base.
Place the 40 × 18 cm base flat.
Stand the front side on the base front edge.
Stand the back side on the base back edge.
Fit the first 14 cm end between the sides.
Fit the second 14 cm end between the sides.
Drive screws through front into first end.
Drive screws through front into second end.
Drive screws through back into first end.
Drive screws through back into second end.
Drive screws upward through base into front.
Drive screws upward through base into back.
Drive a screw upward through base into first end.
Drive a screw upward through base into second end.
Place first foot under base, 6 cm from its start.
Place second foot under base, 28 cm from its start.
Drive short screws through base into first foot.
Drive short screws through base into second foot.
